level_note: Dead Sea -401 m, Sea of Galilee -209 m, Mediterranean 0 m

bodies.name: Mediterranean Sea
bodies.source: Natural Earth 10m ocean polygon clipped to the map bbox. No independent published area reference for the clipped frame, so no +/-5% claim is made.

bodies.name: Dead Sea
bodies.source: Natural Earth 10m north-pool outline at -401 m (south basin excluded: only 6.4% of it lies below -401 m). Measured on the shipped vector, site holes subtracted.

bodies.name: Sea of Galilee
bodies.source: Natural Earth 10m outline (union) at -209 m, minus the 250 m Capernaum and Tiberias site holes so the lakeside towns stand on dry ground. Measured on the shipped vector.

rivers.source: OSM Overpass waterway=river/stream (cached response; offline rebuild)

rebuild.offline: ISRAEL3D_OFFLINE=1 by default - Overpass mirrors are routinely 502/504; the cached response is used instead of waiting ~15 min.
